Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

We're writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform needed additional certification steps beyond what was originally scoped, and that process has taken longer than the vendor initially indicated. As a result, the project delivery date has moved by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team is continuing work on all other components in parallel, and this adjustment is limited to the certification dependency rather than any broader issue with the build. We will keep you informed if anything changes between now and delivery.

Does 14 April still work with your internal launch plans, or is there a scheduling constraint on your end we should factor in?
